ramathibodi.description: DXA BMD/VFA: archive; 40 unique BMD + 20 VFA; 20 mask files

hipray.description: 139 conventional hip X-rays + 139 masks, 256x256; anatomy only, not DXA quality labels

mtddh.description: Optional original pediatric pelvis X-ray archive; not adult DXA

medpelvis3d.description: 99 pelvic CT cases, masks, 57 expert 3D landmarks per case, meshes and point clouds. Transfer/geometry assessment only; not DXA quality ground truth. File-type archives selected to avoid duplicate case/sample archives.

lumase.description: 663 cropped lumbar CT vertebrae L1-L5, seven anatomical regions, three physician annotations. Anatomy/transfer only, not DXA quality labels.

ppcnet-2d.description: All 1037 patients: AP/lateral synthetic lumbar DRRs, projection matrices and ground truth point clouds + original splits. CT volumes, masks and redundant filled clouds excluded to avoid 69GB duplicate imaging bulk. Not clinical DXA quality ground truth.
ppcnet-2d.license: MIT declared by publisher; preserve upstream CT dataset attribution/terms, check README before redistribution

pelvic-tilt.description: Lateral pelvic radiographs and/or five-reader landmark annotations; transfer for projection/landmark uncertainty, not DXA QC ground truth

pelvic-tilt-annotations.description: Lateral pelvic radiographs and/or five-reader landmark annotations; transfer for projection/landmark uncertainty, not DXA QC ground truth

pelvis-anatomical-landmarks.description: 20 pelvic 3D landmark annotation files and origin/CT geometry metadata plus explanatory figure; source CT images not included
pelvis-anatomical-landmarks.license: Repository GPL-3.0; no separate dataset licence established. Keep attribution, review data rights before redistribution.

deepfluoro.description: Author mirror: six cadaver pelvis CT/X-ray pairs, fluoroscopy masks, 2D/3D fiducials, projection geometry; not DXA QC labels
deepfluoro.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 upstream; see deepfluoro/LICENSE; modified author mirror, keep original attribution

femur-fluoroscopy.description: Author mirror: femur CT/X-ray pairs with masks and geometry; transfer/registration only, not DXA quality labels
femur-fluoroscopy.license: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 in femur/LICENSE of pinned author mirror; preserve original provenance; no automatic inclusion in a redistributed product

lumbar-spine-raw1200.description: Original 1200 sagittal lumbar images with semantic masks; author mirror of Mendeley zg4d3f9kyf; augmented derivatives excluded; source overlap must be audited
lumbar-spine-raw1200.license: CC BY 4.0 in author Hugging Face README and original Mendeley record

verse19-metadata.description: Official dataset documentation, license, changes and available subject metadata; not the image cohort
verse19-metadata.license: CC BY-SA 4.0; see license.txt and required dataset citations
